feedback_content_placeholder: Describe the problem or suggestion — the more specific the better (when / device / steps)
feedback_err_content: Describe it in at least 10 characters so we can locate the problem
feedback_contact_note: Optional — we reply through in-app messages (Messages).
feedback_lifecycle_note: After submitting it shows Processing; once support replies it flips to Replied and lands in your Messages; a follow-up flips it back to Processing.
feedback_followup_ok: Follow-up sent · status back to Processing
feedback_followup_note: A follow-up flips the ticket back to Processing and notifies support again.
feedback_closed_note: This feedback is closed; open a new one for a new question.
